title: True Scale Ideas
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · True Scale · round 2 ideas
heading: True Scale: other ways to convey it
intro: Round 4: the two flashes for the locked shape (Bob, 134,210, a home, 303,185 + 267,894). Clean room, one writer each. Bob is from his Camping reference sheet (his looks never described). Pick one Bob and one home. The bomber maybe and round 2's ideas are folded below.

groups.title: 1. Bob (flash)
groups.line: A regular bloke who lost it all in 2008, not "them".

opts.label: BO4-a: Small in the empty car park: wide, low, one lamp
BO4-b: Beside the doors: close profile, shoppers as blurred legs
BO4-c: Through your windscreen: he looks back
BO4-c2: Through your windscreen: he looks back (second take)

groups.title: 3. A warm, lit, happy home (flash)
groups.line: The one warm thing in the film.

opts.label: HM4-a: Outside looking in: glowing front-room window on a cold teal terrace
HM4-b: Inside at the dinner table: warm pendant lamp, teal night pressed on the glass
HM4-c: Coming home: front door opens, lamp light spills on a wet step

sections.lede: Four example stills, our own drawn bomber, no copied diagram.

groups.title: The bomber (survivorship bias)
groups.line: Armour where there are no holes: the planes hit there never came back. The armour is a home.

opts.label: BM3-a: Night hangar, cheap colour film, cold teal fluorescent, the holes chalk-ringed
BM3-b: Period look on purpose: the reveal as a 1940s pencil diagram on graph paper under a desk lamp
BM3-c: Present-day England, high angle: the doorway everyone sees vs the hostel windows nobody counts
BM3-d: The armour as a home: a sealed empty terraced house, steel sheet on the window as armour, one stencilled number

sections.lede: Setup on the left, reveal on the right.

groups.title: Musical chairs backwards
groups.line: The housing crisis as musical chairs, except there are four chairs per kid and one kid is still out.

opts.label: MC2-a: setup: low wide from behind the children, the game in motion
MC2-b: reveal: straight top-down on the ring, the music has stopped

groups.title: Sunbed towels at dawn
groups.line: The great British sunbed war: rows of loungers bagsied with towels at 6am, nobody on them, and one family with nowhere to put their bags.

opts.label: ST2-a: setup: low wide, pool at 5am, every lounger towelled, nobody there
ST2-b: reveal: high angle, rows of claimed empty loungers, families standing with bags

groups.title: Homework marked correct
groups.line: A kid's maths homework: 'There are 4 houses and 1 family. How many families have no house?' The kid writes 1. The teacher ticks it.

opts.label: HW2-a: setup: overhead night shot of a child's maths homework on a worn kitchen table, teal fluorescent cast, film grain
HW2-b: reveal: close-up of the answer box, a pencilled '1' and a bold red tick, same teal night light

groups.title: Sold out stockroom
groups.line: The corner shop's 'SORRY, SOLD OUT' sign on an empty shelf, and through the stockroom door, crates piled to the ceiling.

opts.label: SO2-a: setup: lonely night corner-shop aisle, empty shelf, handwritten SORRY, SOLD OUT card, figure from behind, teal strip lights, film grain
SO2-b: reveal: through the propped stockroom door, plain shrink-wrapped cases stacked floor to ceiling under one bare teal tube, untouched

groups.title: Allotment waiting list
groups.line: Ten years on the allotment waiting list, while behind the padlocked gate whole plots are gone to brambles and nobody's been in years.

opts.label: AL2-a: setup: from behind, a lone figure at a padlocked allotment gate at night, holding the council letter, under one cold teal security lamp
AL2-b: reveal: over the fence, a few tended plots and twice as many gone to brambles, rotting sheds and an empty deckchair, lit cold teal

groups.title: Party bags for no shows
groups.line: End of a kids' party: a table of party bags with names on, most for kids who never came, and the one kid who did leaves empty-handed.

opts.label: PB2-a: setup: a crowded table of named party bags in an empty church hall at night, teal tubes, colour-film grain
PB2-b: reveal: four untouched named bags left on the table, one small coated figure leaving empty-handed through the hall door
